metadata.description: 画风DNA生产库 - v5.1，IP命名试点：新增「双城之战」独立画风（IP参考图重建），37种画风（汰换传统媒介、新增美漫/全生态数字画风/IP画风）
metadata.format: dna + constraint + recommended_composition + recommended_lighting, 每条DNA≤800字符，指令性写法
metadata.prompt_structure: 6段式: [质量触发词] + Art style: [dna] [constraint] + [构图策略] + [光影叙事] + [场景] + [人物≤100字]
metadata.quality_trigger: IMG_2094.CR2, 8K ultra HD, cinematic quality, masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed
metadata.optimized_for: Seedream 5.0 Pro, 纯文生图, 3:4竖版, 英文提示词
metadata.curation_note: v5.1试点：以IP命名画风。新增「双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）」独立条目，从IP参考图重建DNA（手绘糙边+色块内部渐变+主观色彩分区+2D/3D混合），与「现代电影感美漫」(Marvel系)并存。v5.0清洗：汰换7个传统媒介/低还原画风(伊藤潤二/维多利亚版画/浮世绘/国风水墨/凡妮塔斯/吉卜力/圣魔之血)，合并3组重复(赛博三合一/黑执事+圣魔之血/港漫+硬朗武侠)，新增10个已验证画风(4美漫+6全生态)。筛选原则：Seedream保真档位优先，淘汰模拟物理媒介，鼓励数字媒介全视觉生态

tested_phases.Phase 0: 提示词结构验证 → 结构A(4段式·画风优先)为最优解
tested_phases.Phase 3: 3条优化验证(极简人物/质量触发词/DNA精简)
tested_phases.Phase 4: 8种强辨识度画风验证，全部成功
tested_phases.Phase 5: 36种画风全量验证，0失败，辨识度评估完成
tested_phases.Phase 6: 6段式提示词升级测试，5风格×2构图=10张，新海诚达Pinterest级A档，凡妮塔斯D档失败(水彩被暗色吞噬)
tested_phases.Phase 7: LT2柔光通透/LT3平光漫射验证，8张全成功。凡妮塔斯D→B拯救成功，浮世绘/水墨LT3保护成功B+，轻小说A档
tested_phases.Phase 8: 全视觉生态扩容验证：美漫4风格(极简线稿93.3%/电影感92%/经典漫威8/10/概念艺术78) + 全生态6风格(波普90/低多边形92/电影海报87/超现实8.7/扁平矢量4.35/极简线条84.1)，10/10全成功

key_learnings: 极简人物描述(100字)显著释放画风表达空间
质量触发词(IMG_2094.CR2)稳定提升材质和光影35-50%
画风DNA精简到≤800字符+指令性写法有效提升风格执行力
结构A(画风优先)符合Seedream注意力权重分配机制
6段式提示词结构(加入构图+光影维度)显著提升审美品质，新海诚风格达到Pinterest级A档
剪影悬念构图在缩略图辨识度上普遍优于尺度操控，更适合Pinterest传播
减法照明(LT1)与暗色风格天然兼容，但会吞噬水彩/柔美风格(凡妮塔斯D档失败)
风格与光影的兼容性是关键变量，需为柔美风格使用LT2柔光通透模板
并发出图(5线程)将10张测试从30分钟压缩到4分钟，效率提升7.5倍
LT2柔光通透成功拯救水彩风格：凡妮塔斯从D档提升到B档，水彩质感(透明晕染/色彩渗透)存活
LT3平光漫射成功保护平面/传统媒介风格：浮世绘B+(色块+粗线存活)，水墨B+(笔墨晕染+留白存活)
轻小说插画风+LT2获得A档，柔光通透与理想化角色设计天然适配
吉卜力风格+LT2仅C+，问题不在光影而在场景——暗黑哥特场景与吉卜力温暖田园气质冲突
光影模板与风格的兼容性矩阵验证完成：LT1(暗黑系)/LT2(柔美系)/LT3(平面系)三分法有效
画风收集突破漫画圈：Seedream还原度取决于媒介(数字vs传统)而非题材(漫画/概念/滤镜)。数字媒介全生态画风(矢量/3D/图形设计)高保真还原，传统物理媒介(水墨/线刻/铜版)被抹平
美漫风格验证：极简线稿93.3%(Sin City/Hellboy级)、电影感美漫92%、经典漫威8/10，数字印刷感(网点/硬边/限制色板)是美漫在Seedream还原的关键
全生态画风验证：波普90/低多边形92/电影海报87/超现实8.7/扁平矢量4.35/极简线条84.1，全部通过，证明AI时代漫画画风可来自全视觉生态

黑执事.name: 黑执事
黑执事.dna: Art style by Yana Toboso from Black Butler manga, dark Victorian gothic aesthetic. Clean precise linework with bold contrast, sharp angular lines for dramatic effect. Thick confident outlines for characters, geometric precision in architectural elements. Rich deep color palette: black, crimson, gold, deep purple. Saturated jewel tones with flat cel-shading. Pale skin with cool undertones, metallic sheen on gold and brass. Dramatic chiaroscuro with strong contrast, theatrical spotlight illumination, candlelit warm golden glow. Deep black shadows with no detail, rim lighting on characters against dark backgrounds. 7 head proportion, sharp angular features, narrow intense eyes, aristocratic posture. Decadent aristocratic darkness, operatic drama, refined horror, Victorian manor interiors.
黑执事.constraint: Must maintain clean precise linework and cel-shaded coloring. No watercolor. No soft painterly blending. No photorealistic. No cartoonish. Keep sharp contrast and dark gothic elegance. No text overlay.

赛博边缘行者.name: 赛博边缘行者
赛博边缘行者.dna: Art style from Cyberpunk Edgerunners by Studio Trigger, Hiroyuki Imaishi direction. Bold thick outlines with deliberate irregularity, dynamic energetic linework. Lines vary in thickness for speed and impact, sharp angular strokes for mechanical elements. High saturation fluorescent palette: neon pink, electric blue, acid green, warning yellow. Deep blacks and dark purples, flat cel-shading with sharp boundaries. Glowing cybernetic effects, extreme high contrast lighting. Neon glow from below and sides, deep shadows with colored rim lights. 6.5 head proportion, dynamic exaggerated, sharp angular faces, expressive eyes. Dystopian urban energy, high-tech low-life, speed violence and rebellion.
赛博边缘行者.constraint: Must maintain bold outlines and cel-shaded coloring. High saturation neon colors. No watercolor. No soft pastel. No painterly blending. No realistic proportions. Keep dynamic anime style. No text overlay.

日系赛璐珞.name: 日系赛璐珞
日系赛璐珞.dna: Clean cel-shading Japanese anime style, bold visible outline strokes, flat color fills with no soft blending. Clean precise linework with consistent bold outlines, closed line art with no gaps. Clear separation between character and background, geometric and tidy. Flat color fills with two-tone cel shading, sharp highlight edges. Vibrant saturated palette with bright primary colors, flat skin tones with simple blush marks. High contrast between base color and shadow color, no gradient transitions. Simple two-tone lighting: base light and cel shadow, harsh but clean shadow boundaries. Sharp white specular highlights, no atmospheric or ambient lighting effects. 7 head proportion, large expressive eyes, small nose and mouth, youthful cute features.
日系赛璐珞.constraint: Must maintain bold visible outline strokes and flat color fills. No soft gradient blending. No photorealistic. No cinematic concept art. No 3D rendering. No text overlay.

日系热血战斗.name: 日系热血战斗
日系热血战斗.dna: Modern Japanese shonen manga style, dynamic action from Shonen Jump series like Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen. Bold outlines with varying thickness, thick for impact, fine for quiet scenes. Speed lines and action lines, screen tone patterns for texture. Vibrant saturated colors: bright blues, fiery oranges, crisp whites. Flat cel-shading with sharp contrast, bold color blocking for character recognition. High contrast action lighting, dramatic spotlights for special moves, glowing aura effects. Motion blur and impact flashes, bold white highlights against dark backgrounds. 6.5-7 head proportion, large expressive eyes, exaggerated expressions, dynamic foreshortening. Energetic and exciting, friendship and rivalry, high stakes battles.
日系热血战斗.constraint: Must maintain bold outlines and cel-shaded coloring. Vibrant saturated colors. Screen tone texture. No painterly style. No watercolor. No photorealistic. Keep dynamic shonen manga aesthetic. No text overlay.

轻喜剧Q版.name: 轻喜剧Q版
轻喜剧Q版.dna: Cute slice-of-life manga style, soft wholesome aesthetic from modern comedy manga like Spy x Family. Soft rounded linework with consistent gentle thickness, no sharp angles, everything curved. Simple clean lines, minimal detail, cute chibi-style exaggeration. Bright warm pastel palette: soft pink, mint green, butter yellow, baby blue. Flat cel-shading with soft edges, clean bright colors, no dark tones, gentle gradient overlays. Bright even lighting, no harsh shadows, soft warm natural light, sunny and cheerful. 4-5 head proportion, large round eyes, small noses and mouths, big heads, short limbs, round bodies. Warm and wholesome, comfortable and safe, gentle humor, everyday joy, found family and friendship.
轻喜剧Q版.constraint: Must maintain soft rounded linework and bright pastel palette. No sharp angles. No dark atmosphere. No horror elements. No realistic proportions. Keep cute and wholesome. No text overlay.

少女水彩言情.name: 少女水彩言情
少女水彩言情.dna: Shoujo watercolor manga style, delicate soft lineart with watercolor wash coloring and bleeding edges. Fine thin strokes, soft edges blending into coloring, graceful flowing lines. Watercolor wash with bleeding edges, soft pastel macaron palette: pink, lavender, baby blue, mint. Semi-transparent layers with visible wash texture, soft gradient transitions. Flowers and sparkle decorative elements, soft dreamy glow, no harsh shadows. Backlighting with ethereal halos, warm golden hour light, bokeh effects. 7 head proportion, large teary eyes with sparkling highlights, petite slender figures. Dreamy romance, tender emotions, fairy-tale quality, pure and innocent love.
少女水彩言情.constraint: Must maintain delicate soft lineart and watercolor wash coloring. Keep pastel macaron palette. No dark heavy themes. No thick oil texture. No realistic proportions. No harsh contrast. No text overlay.
少女水彩言情.phase7_note: 马卡龙色板出色，水彩模拟良好

新海诚电影风.name: 新海诚电影风
新海诚电影风.keywords: 光影极致·通透梦幻·壁纸级
新海诚电影风.dna: Makoto Shinkai cinematic anime style. Breathtaking luminous lighting with dreamlike color gradients. Crystal-clear transparent skies with volumetric cloud rendering. Rich saturated colors: deep oranges, purples, and blues blending seamlessly. Light refraction and lens flare effects, god rays through clouds. Hyper-detailed backgrounds with photographic precision, city streets and trains meticulously rendered. Delicate cel-shading with soft gradient transitions on characters. Signature Shinkai blue sky, pink-purple-orange sunset gradients. Tender emotional atmosphere with poetic melancholy, sense of distance and longing. Digital compositing precision, clean polished frames, no hand-drawn roughness.
新海诚电影风.constraint: Must maintain Shinkai cinematic quality with luminous lighting and transparent colors. No dark horror tones. No gritty textures. No flat 2D coloring. Keep dreamlike atmosphere. No text overlay.

京都动画萌系.name: 京都动画萌系
京都动画萌系.keywords: 京阿尼脸·细腻日常·柔光
京都动画萌系.dna: Kyoto Animation studio style, KyoAni aesthetic. Signature KyoAni face design: round faces, large eyes with rich multi-layered highlights, detailed irises. Extremely detailed and silky hair rendering with individual strand highlights. Soft and transparent lighting with gentle warmth, filter-like glow effect. Shallow depth of field, bokeh backgrounds like DSLR photography. Meticulous daily life details: uniform wrinkles, tea cup reflections, hair flips. Clean polished digital linework, consistent quality, smooth and fluid. Realistic backgrounds with school and suburban settings, props rendered with care. 7.5 head proportion, idealized but natural, graceful posture. Warm healing atmosphere, quiet beauty in everyday moments, gentle and sincere.
京都动画萌系.constraint: Must maintain KyoAni signature face design and silky hair rendering. No dark themes. No gritty textures. No flat cel-shading without highlights. Keep warm transparent lighting and detailed daily life aesthetic. No text overlay.

大友克洋硬核.name: 大友克洋硬核
大友克洋硬核.dna: Katsuhiro Otomo AKIRA style, hard-core cyberpunk manga aesthetic. Rough powerful linework with bold strokes, distinctive gritty and aggressive line quality. Exaggerated perspective and foreshortening, extreme camera angles. Meticulously detailed mechanical rendering: motorcycles, cybernetic parts, futuristic equipment. Dynamic motion blur and speed effects, sense of unstoppable force. High contrast coloring with industrial palette: steel gray, rust orange, neon accents. Film grain texture overlay, retro analog feel, VHS-like quality. 7.5 head proportion, semi-realistic, strong jawlines, intense expressions. Hardcore cyberpunk tension, urban decay, technological sublime, apocalyptic energy. Everything feels heavy, solid, and dangerous.
大友克洋硬核.constraint: Must maintain rough gritty linework and mechanical detail. No soft watercolor. No cute proportions. No clean polished digital look. Keep film grain and high contrast. No text overlay.

轻小说插画风.name: 轻小说插画风
轻小说插画风.dna: Japanese light novel cover illustration style. Clean refined linework with elegant curves, moderate line weight. Soft luminous coloring with airy gradients, semi-transparent layered shading. Beautiful and idealized character design, attractive and appealing. Soft bokeh backgrounds slightly out of focus, drawing attention to character. Dreamy lighting with gentle glow effects, sparkles and light particles. Warm pastel-leaning palette with vivid accent colors for hair and eyes. Detailed costume and accessory design, flowing fabric and ornamental details. 8 head proportion, elongated elegant, large sparkling eyes with intricate iris detail. Romantic and fantastical, aspirational beauty, quiet emotional undertone.
轻小说插画风.constraint: Must maintain soft luminous quality and idealized beauty. No photorealistic. No dark horror. No gritty texture. No flat cel-shading. Keep dreamy atmospheric lighting. No text overlay.
轻小说插画风.phase7_note: 柔光与理想化角色设计天然适配，A档

90年代复古动漫.name: 90年代复古动漫
90年代复古动漫.dna: 1990s retro anime style, classic cel animation aesthetic. Traditional cel-painted look with visible paint texture, slight color misalignment between line and paint. Bold but slightly rough outlines, hand-drawn imperfection, organic wobble. Limited color palette typical of 90s anime production, slightly faded and desaturated. VHS video tape aesthetic: subtle noise, slight color bleeding, mild scan lines. Film grain and occasional dust scratches, warm analog color cast. Soft and slightly washed-out highlights, no modern digital crispness. Classic anime proportions: 6.5-7 head, large eyes, simple shading. Nostalgic and warm, evoking golden age of anime, physical media charm. Sunset and dusk scenes preferred, lens flare from actual optical artifacts.
90年代复古动漫.constraint: Must maintain 90s cel animation and VHS aesthetic. No modern digital crispness. No photorealistic 3D. No ultra-high definition sharpness. Keep retro analog warmth and imperfection. No text overlay.

天野喜孝幻想.name: 天野喜孝幻想
天野喜孝幻想.dna: Yoshitaka Amano illustration style, ethereal fantasy aesthetic. Delicate wispy linework with ethereal quality, lines seem to float and dissolve. Watercolor and ink mixed media, translucent layered colors with visible paper texture. Muted and sophisticated palette: dusty rose, teal, gold, ivory, lavender. Colors blend and bleed organically, no hard edges. Elongated androgynous figures, 9+ head proportion, impossibly elegant. Fine detailed hair flowing like water, delicate hands and long fingers. Dreamlike and otherworldly, no concern for physical accuracy. Decorative and ornamental, influenced by Art Nouveau and ukiyo-e. Mythic and poetic, figures appear to exist between realms, spiritual and transcendent.
天野喜孝幻想.constraint: Must maintain Amano's ethereal wispy linework and watercolor-ink blend. No photorealistic. No bold thick outlines. No modern anime cel-shading. No digital crispness. Keep dreamlike otherworldly quality. No text overlay.

伪厚涂半厚涂.name: 伪厚涂半厚涂
伪厚涂半厚涂.dna: Semi-thick painting manga style, clean hard outer contour lines with soft gradient shading inside. Visible but not overwhelming outlines, moderate line weight for structure. Cel-shaded base with painterly soft-light overlays, soft gradient inside color blocks. Rich midtones with subtle color variation, warm skin tones with natural undertones. Soft directional lighting with gentle gradients, multiple light sources with temperature shifts. Warm ambient light with cool shadow tones, rim light for depth. 7.5 head proportion, semi-realistic, balanced features, natural anatomy with slight idealization. Modern refined illustration quality, professional commercial manga look, premium webtoon quality.
伪厚涂半厚涂.constraint: Maintain visible outer contour lines and soft gradient shading inside color blocks. No lineless style. No cinematic concept art. No photorealistic 3D rendering. Keep manga readability. No text overlay.

国漫玄幻厚涂.name: 国漫玄幻厚涂
国漫玄幻厚涂.dna: Chinese xianxia painterly manga style, brush-like variable-width lineart with calligraphic quality. Thick bold strokes for main forms, thin delicate lines for details, natural taper from brush pressure. Decorative swirl patterns on costumes, dynamic flowing lines for action. High-saturation glowing magic effects with particle layers, dense Eastern ornamental patterns. Metal and jade material textures, rich warm palette: cinnabar red, gold, jade green, deep blue. Gradient shading with luminous highlights, saturated accents for magical elements. Dramatic lighting with magical glow, warm golden cultivation energy, cool spiritual artifacts. Lens flare and light beams, rim light on characters, atmospheric haze. 7.5 head proportion, elegant refined features, flowing hair and costume silhouettes.
国漫玄幻厚涂.constraint: Maintain brush-like variable-width lineart and Eastern ornamental patterns. Use high-saturation magic effects. No Western fantasy style. No flat cel-shading. No modern clothing. No text overlay.

硬朗武侠历史.name: 硬朗武侠历史
硬朗武侠历史.dna: Gritty wuxia historical manga style, rough carved lineart with bold powerful strokes like Biao Ren. Deliberately uneven aggressive line quality, thick dark contours, minimal detail, maximum impact. Carved scratched quality with ink splash and bleed effects. Low-saturation earthy palette: ochre, burnt sienna, rust red, charcoal gray. Rough texture on all surfaces, weathered aged quality, blood red as accent. High-contrast hard lighting, harsh desert sun or candlelit darkness, deep crushed black shadows. No soft gradients, rim light from intense single sources. Realistic 8 head proportions, rugged masculine features, weathered skin. Ancient China's harsh frontier, gritty realism, survival and violence, weight of history.
硬朗武侠历史.constraint: Maintain rough carved bold lineart and low-saturation earthy palette. Keep high-contrast hard lighting. No soft pretty anime style. No bright saturated colors. No modern elements. No text overlay.

暗黑悬疑高对比.name: 暗黑悬疑高对比
暗黑悬疑高对比.dna: Dark suspense manga style, bold black solid outline lines with large area shadow blackening. Rough aggressive linework, minimal detail, maximum contrast, ink splatter and bleed. Low-saturation desaturated tones, blood-red and sickly-green as accent colors. Heavy black shadows with no detail, sickly pale skin tones, intentionally ugly palette. Extreme high-contrast lighting, single harsh light source, deep black shadows consuming the frame. Bleached-out highlights on faces, unnatural oppressive lighting. Slightly exaggerated proportions, sharp angular gaunt faces, deep set eyes with dark circles. Gritty urban horror, supernatural investigation, constant dread and paranoia.
暗黑悬疑高对比.constraint: Maintain bold black solid lines and extreme high-contrast lighting. Keep desaturated palette with accent colors only. No bright cheerful tones. No soft gradient shading. No pretty anime style. No text overlay.

新国潮风.name: 新国潮风
新国潮风.keywords: 传统混搭·华丽·东方现代
新国潮风.dna: New Chinese Trend illustration style, modern interpretation of traditional Chinese aesthetics. Fusion of traditional elements with contemporary design: cloud patterns, dragon motifs, opera masks. Bold linework combining brush stroke quality with digital precision. Rich saturated palette: vermilion red, mineral blue, gold, ink black. Modern gradient overlays and glow effects on traditional patterns. High contrast dramatic lighting with neon-like accents on classical elements. Detailed costume design mixing hanfu silhouettes with streetwear attitude. Ornamental backgrounds with traditional patterns in modern digital style. 7.5 head proportion, stylish confident, fusion of classical and contemporary beauty. Bold and trendy, cultural pride meets modern cool.
新国潮风.constraint: Must maintain fusion of traditional Chinese elements with modern digital rendering. No pure traditional painting. No flat anime cel-shading. No Western fantasy style. Keep bold saturated colors and cultural motifs. No text overlay.

韩漫暗黑厚涂.name: 韩漫暗黑厚涂
韩漫暗黑厚涂.dna: Korean webtoon dark fantasy manhwa style, professional thick painting technique. Soft or invisible linework, lineless rendering, forms defined by color and value transitions. Thick digital painting with visible brushwork, cold color palette. Deep blues, slate grays, desaturated crimsons, smooth skin rendering with realistic texture. Gradient transitions with no cel boundaries, atmospheric perspective with color temperature shifts. High contrast dramatic lighting, strong rim lights, cold blue ambient with warm accent. Cinematic three-point lighting, deep shadows with color information, luminous glow highlights. 7.5 head proportion, semi-realistic, realistic features with subtle stylization. Gritty dark fantasy, cinematic and immersive, premium webtoon adaptation quality.
韩漫暗黑厚涂.constraint: Must be thick painted style with visible brushwork. No cel-shading. No anime style. No visible ink outlines. No soft watercolor. No cartoonish. Maintain cold color palette and cinematic quality. No text overlay.

韩漫华丽言情.name: 韩漫华丽言情
韩漫华丽言情.dna: Korean webtoon romance manhwa style, luxurious romantic aesthetic. Refined delicate linework with elegant curves, fine strokes for hair and ornaments. Soft contour lines, clean polished digital quality. Soft luminous coloring with airy gradients, warm pastel palette. Rose pink, lavender, cream, champagne gold, pale skin with rosy undertones. Gradient hair highlights, satin and velvet clothing texture, gem-like jewelry sparkle. Soft diffused romantic glow, backlighting with ethereal halos, golden hour quality. 8 head proportion, elegant idealized, large sparkling eyes, extremely slender figures. Romantic fantasy, dreamy and aspirational, opulent settings.
韩漫华丽言情.constraint: Must maintain soft luminous coloring and refined linework. No harsh cel-shading. No thick impasto. No gritty textures. No horror elements. Keep romantic and elegant. No photorealistic. No text overlay.

韩国Webtoon现代风.name: 韩国Webtoon现代风
韩国Webtoon现代风.dna: Modern Korean webtoon style, clean and trendy digital illustration. Clean precise digital linework with consistent weight, vector-like clarity. No unnecessary texture or noise, polished and smooth. Vibrant but controlled color palette, high saturation gradients. Fashionable character design with contemporary hairstyles and streetwear. Detailed clothing renders with fabric texture and fold logic. Soft but directional lighting, gentle gradients with subtle cel-shading influence. Modern UI-adjacent aesthetic, clean composition with strategic use of negative space. 7.5-8 head proportion, attractive and stylish, idealized but contemporary. Fresh and modern, young and trendy, social media aesthetic quality.
韩国Webtoon现代风.constraint: Must maintain clean digital linework and modern trendy aesthetic. No rough textures. No retro analog effects. No dark gothic tones. Keep polished contemporary quality. No text overlay.

哥特暗黑风.name: 哥特暗黑风
哥特暗黑风.keywords: 明暗对比·哥特建筑·暗色调
哥特暗黑风.dna: Gothic dark fantasy art style. Chiaroscuro lighting with extreme contrast between deep shadows and single light sources. Dark desaturated palette: black, crimson, antique gold, deep purple. Ornate Gothic architecture with pointed arches and stained glass. Atmospheric fog and dust particles in light beams. Moody mysterious ominous atmosphere. Intricate filigree patterns on surfaces. Baroque decorative details. Painted with visible brushwork, oil-painting texture.
哥特暗黑风.constraint: Must maintain gothic dark fantasy aesthetic. No bright cheerful colors. No flat cel-shading. No cartoon style. Keep chiaroscuro contrast. No text overlay.

迪士尼皮克斯3D.name: 迪士尼皮克斯3D
迪士尼皮克斯3D.dna: Disney Pixar 3D animation style. Unreal Engine 5 render quality with ray tracing. Subsurface scattering on skin for warm translucent effect. Stylized but appealing character proportions, large expressive eyes with multi-layered reflections. Global illumination with warm cozy lighting. Rich material textures: fabric, wood, metal all distinctly rendered with PBR quality. Vibrant but harmonious color palette. Soft bokeh background with depth of field. Polished commercial animation look, every frame film-quality.
迪士尼皮克斯3D.constraint: Must maintain Pixar 3D animation quality. No 2D cel-shading. No photorealistic. No dark horror tones. Keep warm appealing lighting. No text overlay.

蒸汽朋克黄铜.name: 蒸汽朋克黄铜
蒸汽朋克黄铜.dna: Steampunk aesthetic illustration. Brass copper and bronze metallic surfaces everywhere. Visible gears cogs pipes and steam mechanisms. Warm sepia-toned palette: brass gold, copper green, aged brown, steam white. Victorian industrial revolution atmosphere. Volumetric steam and smoke effects. Intricate mechanical details with ray tracing reflections on metal. Oil-painting texture with visible brushwork on non-metal surfaces. Moody warm lighting from gas lamps and furnaces.
蒸汽朋克黄铜.constraint: Must maintain steampunk aesthetic. No modern technology. No neon colors. No clean futuristic surfaces. Keep brass and copper metallic palette. No text overlay.

暗黑奇幻油画.name: 暗黑奇幻油画
暗黑奇幻油画.keywords: 厚涂笔触·概念图·史诗感
暗黑奇幻油画.dna: Dark fantasy oil painting style, concept art quality. Thick impasto brushwork with visible paint texture. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from single sources. Deep rich palette: dark crimson, burnt orange, deep teal, ash gray. Epic mysterious atmosphere with god rays through clouds. ArtStation trending quality. Detailed environment with atmospheric perspective. Rim light on character for dramatic silhouette. Painted by master digital artist.
暗黑奇幻油画.constraint: Must maintain dark fantasy oil painting quality. No flat anime coloring. No bright pastel. No cartoon style. Keep thick brushwork texture. No text overlay.

穆夏新艺术.name: 穆夏新艺术
穆夏新艺术.dna: Alphonse Mucha Art Nouveau illustration style. Flowing organic decorative lines with whiplash curves. Botanical and floral ornamental borders framing the composition. Warm muted pastel palette: peach, sage green, golden ochre, lavender. Flat decorative coloring with subtle gradients. Elongated elegant feminine proportions. Halos and circular decorative motifs behind characters. Mosaic-like color blocks in background. Fin de siecle elegance, ornamental and luxurious.
穆夏新艺术.constraint: Must maintain Art Nouveau Mucha decorative style. No photorealistic. No modern anime. No dark horror tones. Keep flowing ornamental linework. No text overlay.

废土末日.name: 废土末日
废土末日.dna: Post-apocalyptic wasteland comic style, gritty survival aesthetic. Rough sketchy linework with irregular broken lines, deliberately incomplete and haggard strokes. Heavy cross-hatching for texture, visible eraser and correction marks. Grime and dirt texture built into lines. Desaturated dusty palette: rust brown, olive drab, ash gray, faded khaki. Low saturation with occasional rust-orange or toxic-green accents. Sun-bleached and weather-worn color quality, dirt and grime overlay on all surfaces. Harsh overexposed sunlight or deep darkness, dust-filled volumetric light shafts. Bleached-out highlights with no detail, deep shadows with no ambient light. Realistic proportions with gaunt weathered features, emaciated or heavily scarred bodies.
废土末日.constraint: Must maintain rough sketchy linework and desaturated dusty palette. Keep extreme high-contrast lighting. No clean polished look. No bright colors. No pretty or romantic elements. No futuristic sleek sci-fi. No text overlay.

经典漫威美漫.name: 经典漫威美漫
经典漫威美漫.keywords: 粗线·硬边色块·英雄比例
经典漫威美漫.dna: Art style of classic Marvel Comics, Jim Lee and Joe Madureira era American comic book. Bold confident ink outlines with dynamic line weight, thick heroic outlines. Clean flat cel-shading with strong 2-3 tone shadow blocks, high contrast. Vibrant saturated superhero palette: hero red, navy blue, gold, bold primaries. Halftone dot and screen texture on shaded areas. 8 head proportion, exaggerated heroic muscular figures, square jaw, dynamic action poses. Dramatic high-contrast lighting, bold rim light, epic cinematic composition.
经典漫威美漫.constraint: Keep bold ink outlines and flat cel-shading. Halftone texture. No painterly blending. No anime style. No realistic photography. No watercolor. No text overlay.

现代电影感美漫.name: 现代电影感美漫
现代电影感美漫.keywords: 半写实·电影调色·跨媒介
现代电影感美漫.dna: Art style of modern Marvel cinematic comic tie-in art, Alex Ross influenced digital painting. Semi-realistic painterly rendering with clean confident structural lines. Digital painting with visible brushwork and rich cinematic color grading. Muted-to-vibrant controlled palette with teal-and-orange accents. Cinematic lighting with dramatic contrast, atmospheric depth. Realistic-but-heroic proportions, grounded weight. Golden hour and dramatic rim lighting, epic cinematic composition.
现代电影感美漫.constraint: Keep semi-realistic painterly rendering with clean lines. Cinematic color grading. No anime style. No flat cel-shading. No cartoonish. No photorealistic. No text overlay.

双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）.name: 双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）
双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）.keywords: 手绘糙边·厚涂·青橙·2D/3D混合
双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）.dna: Art style of Arcane League of Legends by Fortiche Studio, hand-painted cinematic thick paint. Painterly rendering with deliberately rough hand-drawn edges, color blocks with broken irregular borders instead of clean vector lines. Thick-paint color flatting with gradients INSIDE each color block, not blended at boundaries. Subjective color zoning on faces: forehead warm yellow, cheekbones pink-orange, eye sockets purple, jaw/neck cool blue. Film teal-orange contrast with saturated cool shadows and warm highlights. 2D hand-painting mixed with 3D rendering feel, visible brush texture. Slightly exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, stylized recognizable faces, asymmetric design. Steampunk industrial city, hand-crafted imperfect cinematic feel.
双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）.constraint: Keep rough hand-drawn edges and thick-paint color flatting. Gradients inside color blocks, not boundary blending. Subjective color zoning on faces. No clean vector lines. No anime cel-shading. No photorealistic. No smooth airbrushing. Keep painterly imperfect cinematic feel. No text overlay.
双城之战（手绘厚涂电影感）.ip_notes: 试点IP命名画风。从Pinterest参考图(画风教程+角色特写)重建DNA，手绘糙边+色块内部渐变+主观色彩分区+2D/3D混合。对比「现代电影感美漫」(Marvel系)差异显著，需独立条目。

美漫极简线稿.name: 美漫极简线稿
美漫极简线稿.dna: Art style of modern American alternative comics, bold minimalist linework style. Thick confident black ink outlines with flat clean color fills. Graphic poster-like composition, strong silhouette shapes. Limited bold palette: black, red, white, one accent. Flat cel coloring with no gradients, graphic halftone washes. 7.5 head proportion, angular stylized faces, bold expressive poses. Strong graphic design sensibility, high contrast.
美漫极简线稿.constraint: Keep bold minimal ink outlines and flat graphic color fills. Halftone washes. No painterly rendering. No anime. No soft gradients. No text overlay.

好莱坞概念艺术.name: 好莱坞概念艺术
好莱坞概念艺术.keywords: 体积光·大气透视·电影氛围
好莱坞概念艺术.dna: Art style of Hollywood blockbuster film concept art, trending on ArtStation for cinematic sci-fi drama. Rich painterly rendering with strong atmospheric depth and color grading. Cinematic volumetric lighting, atmospheric haze, dramatic contrast. Muted cinematic palette with glowing accent colors. Semi-realistic grounded proportions. Epic narrative composition, focus on mood and atmosphere over detail.
好莱坞概念艺术.constraint: Keep cinematic concept art painterly rendering. Volumetric lighting and atmosphere. No comic style. No anime. No flat cel-shading. No text overlay.

电影院线海报.name: 电影院线海报
电影院线海报.keywords: 戏剧构图·垂直压迫·片名空间
电影院线海报.dna: Modern Hollywood thriller movie poster art, theatrical key art style. Dramatic cinematic composition with strong center focus, bold typography-negative space balance. Rich painterly rendering with cinematic color grading, deep contrast. Compressed atmospheric depth, volumetric fog, single dramatic light source. Muted-to-vibrant controlled palette with strong focal accent. Heroic silhouettes against vast environments, scale contrast. Semi-realistic grounded proportions, expressive faces under dramatic light. Moodier than standard poster, high emotional impact, premium box-office quality.
电影院线海报.constraint: Keep cinematic movie poster rendering. Dramatic composition. No comic style. No anime. No flat cel-shading. No text overlay. Keep painterly cinematic quality.

扁平矢量插画.name: 扁平矢量插画
扁平矢量插画.keywords: 几何色块·微渐变·时尚感
扁平矢量插画.dna: Modern flat vector illustration style, trending on Behance for editorial fashion design. Clean sharp geometric shapes, smooth bezier curves, no texture. Bold limited color palette with flat color blocks, no gradients. Strong silhouette shapes, simplified forms. Graphic design sensibility, abstract and minimal. Modern trendy aesthetic, high fashion editorial, striking composition. Flat poster-like clarity, professional print quality.
扁平矢量插画.constraint: Keep flat vector shapes and clean geometry. No texture. No gradients. No painterly. No photorealistic. No 3D. No text overlay. Keep minimal graphic style.

波普艺术.name: 波普艺术
波普艺术.dna: Andy Warhol and Roy Lichtenstein pop art style, bold graphic comic-inspired aesthetic. Thick black outlines with halftone dot patterns, ben-day dots. Flat saturated primary colors: red, yellow, blue, black. Bold high contrast, graphic poster quality. Magazine and advertisement aesthetic, celebrity pop culture. Flat printing reproduction, roster color blocks. Repetitive graphic motifs, bold stencil-like shapes. High impact, commercial graphic design.
波普艺术.constraint: Keep pop art halftone dots and bold flat colors. No painterly. No photorealistic. No 3D. Keep graphic comic-adjacent style. No text overlay.

超现实梦境.name: 超现实梦境
超现实梦境.keywords: 空间悖论·时间异化·梦境
超现实梦境.dna: Surrealist digital art style, Salvador Dali and Rene Magritte inspired dreamscape. Impossible dreamlike juxtapositions, melting and floating objects. Rich dreamlike atmosphere with soft volumetric light. Ethereal muted palette with vivid surreal accents. Metaphysical impossible architecture, floating monoliths, sky inversion. Dreamlike symbolism, subconscious imagery. Painterly rendering with luminous depth. Intellectual surrealism, high concept art.
超现实梦境.constraint: Keep surrealist dreamlike imagery and painterly rendering. No realistic literal scene. No comic style. No anime. Keep dreamlike symbolic quality. No text overlay.

低多边形3D.name: 低多边形3D
低多边形3D.keywords: 几何面片·平面着色·游戏感
低多边形3D.dna: Low poly 3D render style, geometric faceted aesthetic from modern indie game art. Deliberately faceted mesh surfaces, triangular planes, visible polygon edges. Flat-shaded or simple gradient lighting with faceted shadows. Muted-to-vibrant palette with color variation across facets. Minimalist geometric composition, stylized simplified forms. Clean modern game-ready aesthetic, soft ambient occlusion. Trendy on ArtStation, appealing abstract 3D quality.
低多边形3D.constraint: Keep low poly faceted geometry and flat-shaded lighting. No smooth high-poly. No photorealistic. No painterly. No anime. No text overlay. Keep geometric minimal style.

极简线条插画.name: 极简线条插画
极简线条插画.dna: Minimalist one-line concept art style, trending on Instagram for modern minimal design. Single continuous flowing line art, graceful unbroken strokes. Negative space dominant, minimal ink on clean background. Elegant abstract forms, subtle emotion through line curvature. Muted monochrome palette: black ink, paper white, one muted accent. Zen-like simplicity, refined sophisticated minimalism. Decorative line art quality, premium editorial aesthetic.
极简线条插画.constraint: Keep continuous minimal line art and dominant negative space. No filled shapes. No painterly. No photorealistic. No comic. No text overlay. Keep minimal elegant line aesthetic.

CT1_scale_contrast.name: 尺度操控
CT1_scale_contrast.desc: Composition: Vast environment dominates the frame, character is small in the lower third as a scale reference. Negative space above with atmospheric texture and depth. Character faces away from viewer, looking toward the distant horizon. Extreme wide shot, environment as primary subject, figure as narrative anchor.
CT1_scale_contrast.best_for: 史诗/电影感风格，环境叙事为主的场景

CT2_silhouette_back.name: 剪影悬念
CT2_silhouette_back.desc: Composition: Character shown from behind in three-quarter back view, face partially obscured by shadow and hair. Tight cropping on upper body. Mystery through concealment. Single light source from front creating dramatic backlit silhouette. Rim lighting on shoulders and hair edges. Figure as viewing proxy, audience sees what character sees.
CT2_silhouette_back.best_for: 神秘/氛围感风格，角色代入感强的场景

LT1_subtractive.name: 减法照明
LT1_subtractive.desc: Lighting: Subtractive lighting, 80% of image in deep atmospheric shadow. Only key features selectively illuminated. Edge rim lighting on silhouette. Darkness as active narrative presence, not absence. Multi-layer fog and atmospheric haze creating depth. Cold dominant palette with single warm focal point ≤10% of frame.
LT1_subtractive.best_for: 暗黑/哥特/恐怖/赛博风格，与暗色场景天然兼容
LT1_subtractive.warning: 会吞噬水彩/柔美风格，此类风格应改用LT2柔光通透模板

LT2_soft_luminous.name: 柔光通透
LT2_soft_luminous.desc: Lighting: Soft luminous lighting with gentle diffused glow. Light emanates from within the image, characters remain visible and readable. Warm ambient light with cool shadow undertones. Backlighting with ethereal halos, golden hour quality. Bokeh and light particles. No crushed blacks, shadows retain color information. Luminous shadows, preserving figure readability even in dark scenes.
LT2_soft_luminous.best_for: 水彩/柔美/治愈/明亮风格，保护柔美画风不被暗色场景吞噬
LT2_soft_luminous.warning: 不适用于纯暗黑风格，会削弱黑暗氛围
LT2_soft_luminous.note: v4.0新增模板，Phase 7验证通过：成功拯救水彩风格(D→B)，轻小说插画风获A档

LT3_flat_atmospheric.name: 平光漫射
LT3_flat_atmospheric.desc: Lighting: Flat even illumination with minimal directional lighting. Light distributed uniformly across the scene, no dramatic shadows. Atmospheric depth through color and mist rather than light/shadow contrast. Subtle ambient occlusion only. Medium-key lighting, neither high nor low contrast. Natural diffuse light like overcast sky or soft window light. Texture and line quality are primary visual carriers, not lighting drama.
LT3_flat_atmospheric.best_for: 平面/矢量/图形风格，光影不应抢夺线条和色块的表达权
LT3_flat_atmospheric.warning: 不适用于需要光影戏剧性的风格
LT3_flat_atmospheric.note: v4.0新增模板，Phase 7验证通过：保护平面画风线条与色块表达
